climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A red DOCG in the hills of Novara province, in Piedmont, from Ghemme and Romagnano Sesia. It is made mainly from Nebbiolo, locally called Spanna, with Uva Rara and Vespolina allowed. It needs at least three years of aging.
